description:
Quotient is an AI-native platform and intelligent agent in one; built to plan and execute campaigns across email, social, blog, and events, without the fragmented tools you've outgrown.

At its core, Quotient is an AI demand marketing platform. It brings everything that attracts customers: blogs, social posts, email, webinars and events, and brand-building, into one integrated workspace. You work with Quotient like a coworker. Describe what you want in plain English, and it takes it from there.

Campaigns organize your marketing around a central goal, like a feature launch or event. Each is a coordinated set of tasks and deliverables moving through a clear workflow. Deliverables are the real assets Quotient creates and ships: blog posts, email broadcasts, marketing events, automated flows, and social posts for X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. Ask Quotient to build a campaign end to end: it writes the brief, breaks the work into tasks, sets the timeline, and produces each deliverable.

Quotient gets smarter over time, drawing on a Knowledge Store of brand information, recording memories of your preferences, and using tools to search the web and pull from your audience of people and companies.

The result is a single platform where strategy, content, and execution live together, replacing the patchwork of disconnected marketing tools with one AI that plans, writes, and ships.

defaultPrompt: Create a launch campaign for our new product, including a brief, tasks, and draft social posts.
Stand up a weekly newsletter program with template, recurring Agent Job, and evergreen campaign to link all email broadcasts to.
List our current campaigns and help me decide what marketing work should happen next.
